name: synthesize_sql_query
title: Deterministic NL-to-SQL Synthesizer & Dialect Query Generator
description: Translates natural language questions into dialect-accurate, optimized SQL SELECT queries with schema awareness and safety checks. Use when generating reporting queries or automated data analytics pipelines; for analyzing SQL execution performance and EXPLAIN plans, use analyze_query_plan instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'natural_language_request' and 'schema_ddl' ('sql_dialect' defaults to 'postgresql_dialect'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

natural_language_request.description: Natural language question or reporting requirement to transform into SQL.

schema_ddl.description: Database schema DDL statements defining available tables, columns, and relations.

sql_dialect.description: Target SQL dialect specification: PostgreSQL dialect, MySQL dialect, or SQLite dialect.

read_only_mode.description: Whether to enforce strict read-only SELECT query constraints.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for synthesize_sql_query.

sql_query.description: Synthesized, formatted SQL query tailored to the provided schema and dialect.

dialect.description: Database engine dialect target the query was generated for.

explanation.description: Step-by-step rationale explaining table joins, filtering predicates, and grouping logic.

safety_checked.description: True if AST static analysis verified the query has zero mutation side-effects.

annotations.title: Deterministic NL-to-SQL Synthesizer & Dialect Query Generator

name: audit_sql_injection_ast
title: Deterministic SQL AST Injection & Tautology Vulnerability Auditor
description: Statically parses SQL queries via AST lexical analysis to detect second-order injection, tautology conditions, and stacked queries. Use when auditing dynamic query parameters or untrusted user input before database execution; for sanitizing query strings for telemetry logging, use sanitize_sql_telemetry instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'raw_sql' ('audit_sensitivity' defaults to 'strict_zero_dynamic_taint'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

raw_sql.description: Raw SQL query string to parse and audit for injection vulnerabilities.

audit_sensitivity.description: Audit sensitivity mode: strict zero dynamic taint, second order injection check, or standard syntax audit.

allow_comments.description: Whether SQL inline comments are allowed or treated as injection vectors.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for audit_sql_injection_ast.

is_safe.description: True if the SQL query passed AST security audit with zero injection indicators.

risk_score.description: Continuous vulnerability score between 0.0 (safe) and 1.0 (critical exploit).

vulnerabilities.description: List of flagged injection mechanisms (e.g., tautology_always_true, stacked_statement, comment_truncation).

ast_fingerprint.description: Normalized structural AST hash of the parsed statement tree.

annotations.title: Deterministic SQL AST Injection & Tautology Vulnerability Auditor

name: analyze_query_plan
title: SQL Query Plan EXPLAIN Optimizer & Bottleneck Diagnostics
description: Analyzes SQL EXPLAIN execution plans to detect sequential table scans, high-cost cartesian joins, and buffer memory bottlenecks. Use when diagnosing slow queries, optimizing database performance, or evaluating query cost; for getting index recommendations, use recommend_database_indexes instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'explain_plan_or_query' ('optimization_target' defaults to 'eliminate_seq_scans'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

explain_plan_or_query.description: Raw text or JSON output of EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE or the candidate SQL query.

optimization_target.description: Optimization goal: eliminate sequential scans, reduce memory buffers, or minimize join costs.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for analyze_query_plan.

bottlenecks_detected.description: Identified query execution bottlenecks (e.g., Seq Scan on large table, Nested Loop join).

estimated_cost_reduction_pct.description: Estimated potential query cost reduction percentage with recommended optimizations.

recommended_rewrites.description: Specific SQL query rewrites and predicate adjustments to improve performance.

annotations.title: SQL Query Plan EXPLAIN Optimizer & Bottleneck Diagnostics

name: detect_breaking_migrations
title: Database Schema Migration Differ & Breaking Change Linter
description: Compares source and target DDL schemas to identify breaking changes, destructive column drops, and lock-inducing mutations. Use when verifying CI/CD migration scripts before production deployment to prevent downtime; for verifying relational normal form, use validate_schema_normalization instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'current_schema' and 'target_schema' ('risk_tolerance' defaults to 'zero_downtime_strict'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

current_schema.description: Current production database DDL schema representing live tables and columns.

target_schema.description: Proposed new database DDL schema representing target migration state.

risk_tolerance.description: Deployment safety policy: zero downtime strict, allow transient locks, or permissive dev.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for detect_breaking_migrations.

breaking_changes_detected.description: True if breaking changes or destructive table mutations were identified.

risk_level.description: Categorical migration risk assessment (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH_LOCK_RISK, CRITICAL_DATA_LOSS).

breaking_operations.description: List of destructive changes (e.g., column dropped, non-null without default, type narrowing).

migration_steps_safe_order.description: Recommended zero-downtime phased rollout steps (expand, migrate, contract).

annotations.title: Database Schema Migration Differ & Breaking Change Linter

name: transpile_sql_dialect
title: Polyglot SQL Dialect Transpiler (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite)
description: Transpiles SQL queries and DDL schemas across PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite dialects, rewriting functions and syntax quirks. Use when migrating application queries across database backends or testing against in-memory SQLite; for generating new queries from natural language, use synthesize_sql_query instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'sql_code' and 'source_dialect' ('target_dialect' defaults to 'sqlite'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

sql_code.description: SQL query or DDL statement to convert from source dialect into target dialect.

source_dialect.description: Original SQL dialect of the input code: postgresql, mysql, or sqlite.

target_dialect.description: Destination SQL dialect to transpile into: postgresql, mysql, or sqlite.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for transpile_sql_dialect.

transpiled_sql.description: Transpiled SQL code compliant with the target database dialect specification.

syntax_transformations.description: List of dialect-specific transformations applied (e.g., NOW() to CURRENT_TIMESTAMP).

compatibility_warnings.description: Potential semantic differences or unsupported features flagged during transpilation.

annotations.title: Polyglot SQL Dialect Transpiler (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite)

name: recommend_database_indexes
title: Database Index Advisor & Composite B-Tree Optimizer
description: Recommends optimal single-column and composite B-Tree/BRIN indexes based on slow query WHERE, JOIN, and ORDER BY clauses. Use when optimizing database response times and eliminating full-table scans; for inspecting full execution plans, use analyze_query_plan instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'slow_queries_or_workload' ('index_type_preference' defaults to 'btree_and_composite'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

slow_queries_or_workload.description: Collection of slow SQL queries or workload log statements to analyze for index gaps.

index_type_preference.description: Target indexing strategy: B-tree and composite, BRIN and GIN sparse, or covering indexes with INCLUDE.

max_new_indexes.description: Maximum number of index creation statements to recommend.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for recommend_database_indexes.

recommended_indexes.description: List of recommended CREATE INDEX DDL statements with target columns.

expected_speedup_factor.description: Estimated average query execution speedup multiple (e.g. 14.5x).

storage_overhead_est.description: Estimated index disk storage footprint overhead impact.

annotations.title: Database Index Advisor & Composite B-Tree Optimizer

name: validate_schema_normalization
title: Relational Schema Normalization Auditor (3NF, BCNF) & Integrity Guard
description: Audits database schemas for third normal form (3NF) compliance, transitive dependencies, and missing foreign key constraints. Use when reviewing database architectures, preventing update anomalies, or validating relational integrity; for detecting breaking schema migrations, use detect_breaking_migrations instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'schema_ddl' ('target_normal_form' defaults to 'third_normal_form_3nf'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

schema_ddl.description: Database schema DDL statements defining table columns, primary keys, and relations.

target_normal_form.description: Target normalization standard: 3NF, Boyce-Codd BCNF, or denormalized OLAP star.

strict_keys.description: Whether to enforce explicit foreign key constraints on all ID references.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for validate_schema_normalization.

conforms_to_target.description: True if the schema strictly satisfies the chosen normal form requirements.

normalization_score.description: Schema relational design quality score on a 0 to 100 scale.

redundancies_flagged.description: List of redundant fields, missing primary keys, or transitive dependencies identified.

refactoring_suggestions.description: Specific table decomposition and foreign key recommendations to achieve compliance.

annotations.title: Relational Schema Normalization Auditor (3NF, BCNF) & Integrity Guard

name: sanitize_sql_telemetry
title: SQL Query Telemetry PII Scrubber & Parameterization Masker
description: Masks PII, financial values, and credential literals from raw SQL query logs and slow-query dumps before telemetry storage. Use when scrubbing production database query logs before shipping to APM tools, Datadog, or external log collectors; for auditing SQL injection vulnerabilities, use audit_sql_injection_ast instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'query_logs' ('masking_policy' defaults to 'mask_pii_and_literals'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

query_logs.description: Raw SQL query text or multi-line database query log strings requiring sanitization.

masking_policy.description: Scrubbing rigor policy: mask PII and literals, anonymize all constants, or strict AST parameterization.

hash_salt.description: Optional salt string for deterministic pseudonymization of user IDs.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for sanitize_sql_telemetry.

sanitized_logs.description: Clean query logs with sensitive constants replaced by parameter placeholders.

redacted_literals_count.description: Total number of strings, numbers, and PII literals scrubbed from logs.

parameterized_templates.description: Normalized abstract query patterns suitable for APM metrics grouping.

annotations.title: SQL Query Telemetry PII Scrubber & Parameterization Masker

name: synthesize_seed_fixtures
title: Deterministic Relational Seed Data & SQL Mock Fixture Generator
description: Generates deterministic relational test seed fixtures respecting foreign key constraints, unique indexes, and data bounds. Use when provisioning mock database datasets for automated testing, staging environments, or sandbox demos; for compiling ORM models from schemas, use generate_orm_models instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'schema_ddl' ('fixture_volume' defaults to 'minimal_smoke_test_5'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

schema_ddl.description: Target database schema DDL defining tables, column types, and foreign key relations.

fixture_volume.description: Mock dataset volume profile: minimal smoke test (5), standard dataset (50), or stress dataset (500).

deterministic_seed.description: Integer seed for reproducible pseudo-random data generation.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for synthesize_seed_fixtures.

sql_inserts.description: Executable SQL INSERT statements populated with realistic mock records.

records_generated_per_table.description: Count of generated records partitioned by target table name.

foreign_keys_satisfied.description: True if all foreign key dependencies and unique constraints were verified valid.

annotations.title: Deterministic Relational Seed Data & SQL Mock Fixture Generator

name: calculate_pool_headroom
title: Database Connection Pool Sizing & Concurrency Headroom Calculator
description: Calculates optimal connection pool sizing, idle timeouts, and client headroom based on server RAM and concurrency profile. Use when sizing PgBouncer, HikariCP, or Prisma connection pools to avoid server out-of-memory crashes; for checking transaction isolation hazards, use audit_transaction_isolation instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'server_ram_mb' and 'max_concurrent_clients' ('workload_profile' defaults to 'high_concurrency_oltp'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

server_ram_mb.description: Total available RAM in megabytes dedicated to the database server instance.

max_concurrent_clients.description: Peak anticipated concurrent client connections or serverless worker threads.

workload_profile.description: Workload operational characteristics: high-concurrency OLTP, heavy analytical OLAP, or serverless edge burst.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for calculate_pool_headroom.

recommended_max_connections.description: Calculated optimal max pool size to avoid database thrashing and memory exhaustion.

recommended_min_idle.description: Recommended standby idle connection count for warm latency response.

connection_timeout_ms.description: Recommended pool connection acquisition timeout in milliseconds.

memory_headroom_mb.description: Estimated unallocated memory buffer in megabytes remaining for query sorting.

annotations.title: Database Connection Pool Sizing & Concurrency Headroom Calculator

name: audit_transaction_isolation
title: Transaction Concurrency Anomaly & Isolation Level Hazard Auditor
description: Audits database transaction workflows for concurrency anomalies, dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and deadlock risks. Use when reviewing financial transfer procedures, inventory decrement operations, or multi-step checkout workflows; for calculating connection pool headroom, use calculate_pool_headroom instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'transaction_steps' ('target_isolation_level' defaults to 'read_committed'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

transaction_steps.description: Sequential SQL commands or description of business operations within the transaction.

target_isolation_level.description: Candidate SQL isolation level: read committed, repeatable read, or serializable.

strict_deadlock_check.description: Whether to perform exhaustive cross-table lock acquisition ordering analysis.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for audit_transaction_isolation.

vulnerable_to_dirty_reads.description: True if transactions could read uncommitted intermediate state from other sessions.

vulnerable_to_phantom_reads.description: True if concurrent inserts could introduce phantom rows between sequential reads.

deadlock_risk.description: Deadlock risk severity rating (NEGLIGIBLE, MODERATE, HIGH_REVERSED_LOCK_ORDER).

recommended_isolation.description: Optimal transaction isolation level to ensure ACID safety for the workload.

annotations.title: Transaction Concurrency Anomaly & Isolation Level Hazard Auditor

name: generate_orm_models
title: SQL DDL to Type-Safe ORM Entity Compiler (Prisma, Drizzle, Zod)
description: Compiles SQL DDL schemas into type-safe ORM entities and TypeScript validation schemas (Prisma, Drizzle, SQLAlchemy, Zod). Use when scaffolding application models, generating TypeScript data layers, or synchronizing schemas; for translating raw SQL across dialects, use transpile_sql_dialect instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'schema_ddl' ('orm_target' defaults to 'drizzle_orm_typescript'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

schema_ddl.description: Database schema DDL statements defining tables, primary keys, and relationships.

orm_target.description: Target ORM framework standard: Prisma schema, Drizzle ORM TypeScript, SQLAlchemy Python 2.0, or Zod types.

include_relations.description: Whether to generate explicit foreign key relation decorators and navigation properties.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for generate_orm_models.

compiled_code.description: Generated type-safe model code matching the specified ORM or validation schema framework.

orm_framework.description: Name of the target ORM framework output produced.

models_generated.description: List of model entity names successfully parsed and compiled from the schema.

annotations.title: SQL DDL to Type-Safe ORM Entity Compiler (Prisma, Drizzle, Zod)
